description: Start a discovery from a saved ICP by its `icpId` (get one from list_icps or save_icp). Debits 100 credits and returns a jobId immediately; the job runs asynchronously (~5-25 min) — poll get_discovery_status, then get_discovery_results, exactly as for find_prospects. An unknown icpId is rejected and the debit is refunded.
name: run_icp
title: Run ICP
